title: Legora announces its plugin for ChatGPT Enterprise
summary: Legora is now available inside ChatGPT Enterprise, giving lawyers a direct line to grounded legal answers with citations.
body_markdown:
Legora, the agentic operating system for legal professionals, today announced its plugin is available in ChatGPT Enterprise. Lawyers working in ChatGPT can ask Legora a legal question and get a grounded answer with citations linking back to Legora for source review.


Available to shared customers at law firms and in-house legal teams, the integration runs through Legora's MCP server, which supports legal questions and jurisdiction-scoped research using Legora's research capabilities.


A lawyer can ask a general legal research question and get a grounded answer that opens straight into the matter behind it in Legora, or get a concise analysis of a contract question with citations to review. Permissions carry over from Legora: a lawyer sees only the documents and threads they already have access to. Anything beyond answering and citing - creating, editing, or exporting documents, task requests, lists, prompts, workflows, or monitors - takes place directly in the[Legora aOS](https://legora.com/product/aos) .


"Lawyers work across a lot of tools, and Legora works where they do. ChatGPT is one of those places, and through this integration, a lawyer can ask a question as it arises without compromising the rigor behind the answer," **said Kristin Thayer, VP, Partnerships at Legora** .


Lawyers can now find and enable the Legora integration through the ChatGPT Plugins Directory.


**About Legora**


Legora is the agentic operating system for legal work, supporting lawyers in research, review, and drafting across complex matters. It is used by more than 100,000 legal professionals at more than 1,800 leading law firms and in-house legal teams across over 50 markets.
